sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, pp.price AS price, ad.addOnProductId AS addOnProductId, ad.addOnName AS addOnName, ch.child1Sku AS child1Sku, ch.child1Name AS child1Name, pp.rp AS retailPrice, pp.sp AS salesPrice, ch.child1Id AS child1ProductId, cp.RetailPrice AS child1RetailPrice, cp.SalesPrice AS child1SalesPrice, br.brandName AS brandName, sd.val AS shortDescription, ad.a1Pr AS addOnPrice, ad.a2Id AS addOn2ProductId, ad.a2Nm AS addOn2Name, ad.a2Pr AS addOn2Price, ad.a3Id AS addOn3ProductId, ad.a3Nm AS addOn3Name, ad.a3Pr AS addOn3Price FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price, pr.RetailPrice AS rp, pr.SalesPrice AS sp FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plp ON plp.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND plp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND pr.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plp.Precedence, pl.PriceListId) pp OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.id END) AS addOnProductId, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.nm END) AS addOnName, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n1 THEN ax.pr END) AS a1Pr, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.id END) AS a2Id, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.nm END) AS a2Nm, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n2 THEN ax.pr END) AS a2Pr, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.id END) AS a3Id, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.nm END) AS a3Nm, MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn = @n3 THEN ax.pr END) AS a3Pr FROM (SELECT ao.PimProductId AS id, ao.ProductName AS nm, MAX(apx.price) AS pr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, ao.PimProductId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(apr.SalesPrice, apr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice apr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList apl ON apl.PriceListId = apr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal aplp ON aplp.PriceListId = apl.PriceListId WHERE apr.SKU = ao.SKU AND aplp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND apr.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND (apl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (apr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY aplp.Precedence, apl.PriceListId, apr.PriceId) apx WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType) GROUP BY ao.PimProductId, ao.ProductName, ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder) ax) ad CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 c.SKU AS child1Sku, c.ProductName AS child1Name, c.PimProductId AS child1Id FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive ORDER BY a.DisplayOrder, c.PimProductId) ch OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 cpr.RetailPrice, cpr.SalesPrice, cpr.PriceListId FROM dbo.ZnodePrice cpr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList cpl ON cpl.PriceListId = cpr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal cpo ON cpo.PriceListId = cpl.PriceListId WHERE cpr.SKU = ch.child1Sku AND cpo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (cpl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR cpl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (cpl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR cpl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (cpr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR cpr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (cpr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR cpr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY cpo.Precedence, cpl.PriceListId, cpr.PriceId) cp OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode = p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId, bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(sta.AttributeValue, sal.AttributeValue) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sav INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute spa ON spa.PimAttributeId = sav.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue sta ON sta.PimAttributeValueId = sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sta.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale sal ON sal.PimAttributeValueId = sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sal.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE sav.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND spa.AttributeCode = @shortDescriptionCode ORDER BY sav.PimAttributeValueId) sd WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) AND EXISTS (SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = c.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE c.SKU = ch.child1Sku AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed) AND EXISTS (SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = c.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId) >= @minAddOns AND (@minAddOns = @none OR ad.addOnProductId IS NOT NULL) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable) >= @minPersonalizableAttributes AND (@personalizationAttribute IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT pa.PimAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable AND pa.AttributeCode = @personalizationAttribute)) AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @publishSuccess AND pe.IsActive = @storefrontActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @storefrontObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) <= @minAddOns AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @none ORDER BY p.SKU
